provenance.instrument: Penn Township (York County) Code Chapter 325 Zoning (Ord. No. 880, 11-17-2025), definitions in Chapter 142, as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 code date 2026-04-20 (breadcrumb). Chapter 325 was replaced by Ord. No. 880 (11-17-2025). New Laws on 2026-11-14: Ord. No. 888 and 889 (2026-08-17), roads and sewer facilities, not zoning.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 breadcrumb 'Code 2026-04-20'. Chapter 325 history: adopted 11-17-2025 by Ord. No. 880. The chapter page still carries an older help note that the ordinance is on the township website.
checks: 'Dwelling, conversion' is a special exception in R-10, R-15, R-22, R-40, Rural Conservation and Mixed Use (325-212, 325-630). 'A single-family dwelling unit may be converted by allowing a second kitchen for the incorporation of one additional dwelling unit for a family member' (325-630A)

The added unit is inside the existing house or added to it, joined by a common wall, floor or ceiling, not just a breezeway or porch, all in one building. Family members are parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren and siblings. At most two people live in it (325-630A, C)

The house is owner-occupied. The permit is renewed every year: a notarized affidavit by January 31 that the owner lives there and a family member occupies the unit, with a fee. When either stops, the unit returns to the single-family residence (325-630B, E, F)

At most 450 sq ft of floor area, unless parts of an existing dwelling can reasonably become 'a slightly larger one bedroom unit' (325-630D). One more all-weather off-street parking space beyond the house's two (325-630H, 325-303)
Utilities: the unit connects to the house's sewer, water and other systems. No separate systems (325-630G)

Elder cottage housing opportunity (ECHO) is a special exception in the same six zones: a portable cottage of 300 to 900 sq ft for one relative at least 60 years old, handicapped or disabled, or a related caregiver, at most two people, sharing the house's utilities, in the side or rear yard at the principal building's side and rear setbacks unless inside an existing building, removed within three months after use ends, bond posted, permit reviewed every 12 months (325-637). One parking space (325-303)

'Lot coverage' is 'The total of impervious areas' (142-2): 65% in R-10, MU and R-15 or R-22 with public water and sewer, 30% otherwise. The house, accessory structures and an elder cottage together stay within it (325-637B)

Detached accessory structures stand in the rear yard and outside the side and rear setbacks, and are otherwise treated as part of the principal building. All accessory building footprints together at most the house footprint (single-story house) or 1.5 times it (multi-story) (325-300B, C)

In residential zones no more than one principal use per lot except by special exception (325-307). The uses by right and by special exception in each zone are the only uses permitted (325-201A). A use neither permitted nor denied goes to the Zoning Hearing Board as a special exception (325-317)
Two-family detached dwellings (duplexes) are permitted by right in R-10 and Mixed Use (325-212). Their standards in 325-635 were not read
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Penn Township (York County) Zoning Officer. eCode360 code PE0541 is Penn Township, York County ('Penn Township, York County, Pennsylvania' in 166-37). Read on eCode360 in a browser, one page at a time, on 2026-11-14. Code search (all content, New Laws included) for 'accessory apartment', 'accessory dwelling', 'in-law', ECHO, 'elder cottage', granny, 'family dwelling', relative, 'housekeeping unit', caretaker, 'guest house', 'accessory living', 'tenant house', 'living quarters', 'second dwelling' and 'accessory residential' found 325-637 (ECHO) and definitions. A second search for 'dwelling, conversion', duplex, 'two-family' and 'accessory use' found 325-630. The principal land use table (325-212) was read on screen to place each mark in its column. Read in full: Articles II (zones, use table) and III (general provisions, parking), 325-630, 325-637, the definitions of conversion dwelling, dwelling unit, single-family detached dwelling and ECHO. Not read: 325-635 (duplex standards), Article V (special exception standards), Article IV (modifications, nonconforming lots), the family definition, the full lot coverage definition (search excerpt only), 325-603 (age-restricted communities).

term.value: dwelling, conversion (additional dwelling unit for a family member)
term.note: 'A single-family dwelling unit may be converted by allowing a second kitchen for the incorporation of one additional dwelling unit for a family member.' The definition: 'A building originally designed and built as a single detached dwelling unit that has been converted into two or more dwelling units.' A separate elder cottage (ECHO, 325-637) is the detached form here.

status.note: Family only, by special exception. The unit in or added to the house is for parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren or siblings (325-630). The detached elder cottage is for a relative at least 60, handicapped or disabled, or a related caregiver (325-637).

status_outside.note: Corridor Business, Shopping/Commercial and Industrial list neither use, nor single-family detached dwellings.

path.note: Zoning Hearing Board special exception for both uses. Article V general standards also apply (not read).

fallback_path.note: Relief from a district rule is a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Two-family detached dwelling (duplex) in R-10 or Mixed Use
value.conditions: Permitted by right in the principal land use table. Standards in 325-635 (not read). Two parking spaces per dwelling. Mixed Use allows at most four dwelling units per gross acre.
value.note: A building of two dwelling units, not an ADU listing. Whether adding a unit to an existing house is read as this use is not said.

building_types.note: A building built as a single detached dwelling unit (definition of conversion dwelling). ECHO sits on a single-family property (142-2).

value.condition: Family members only: parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren and siblings. At most two people in the unit.
One relative (blood, marriage or adoption) of the house's occupants who is at least 60, handicapped or disabled, or a related caregiver of such an occupant. At most two people.
The house is owner-occupied while the permit lasts. Annual notarized affidavit by January 31 and fee.
Inside the existing house or added to it, joined by a common wall, floor or ceiling (not just a breezeway or porch), all in one building.

A portable elder cottage, in the side or rear yard at the principal building's side and rear setbacks unless inside an existing building. Removed within three months after it is no longer occupied by a qualifying person. Bond for removal. Occupancy permit reviewed every 12 months.

Connected to the house's sewer, water and other utility systems. No separate systems (for ECHO, unless the Department of Environmental Protection requires them). With on-site systems, evidence that they can serve both units.
The house, any existing accessory structures and the elder cottage together stay within the zone's maximum lot coverage.

types_allowed.note: Internal and attached: the conversion unit (325-630A). Detached new: a portable elder cottage (325-637A). In an existing accessory building: 325-637F ('Unless provided within an existing building').

value.garage_conversion: Elder cottage (ECHO) inside an existing building

max_sqft_internal.note: 'Shall not exceed 450 square feet of floor area, unless such parts of an existing dwelling are otherwise arranged or designed to be reasonably, conveniently, and safely transformed into a slightly larger one bedroom unit.'

max_sqft_accessory_building.note: Elder cottage: 'a minimum of 300 square feet of floor area and may not exceed 900 square feet'.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: A detached accessory structure may not be in the side and rear setbacks and is otherwise treated as part of the principal building. An elder cottage keeps the principal side and rear setbacks.

front_yard_barred.note: The elder cottage is 'installed and located in the side or rear yards only'. Other detached accessory structures are permitted in rear yards (325-300B).

accessory_height_applies.note: No separate accessory building height. A detached structure is 'considered a part of the principal building' for other requirements, read as taking the district height.

owner_occupancy.note: For the unit in or added to the house. The ECHO section has no owner rule.

occupancy.value: In or added to the house: parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren or siblings, at most two people. Elder cottage: one relative at least 60, handicapped or disabled, or a related caregiver, at most two people.

spaces_required.note: 'A minimum of one all-weather, off-street parking space ... in addition to that required for the principal dwelling.' ECHO: '1 per dwelling' (325-303).

total_on_site.note: Single-family detached dwelling '2 per dwelling' plus one.
